post.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 request of the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP, revision 2026-07-28; 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 served statelessly for clients that open with initialize). Methods server/discover, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read. Every MCP Tool replays an existing read route as the caller, so that route's own gates and masking decide; each tools/call and resources/read leaves an AUDIT row naming the person and the agent client. The answer is raw JSON-RPC, never the v1 envelope. 400 for a malformed body or a header that does not match the body (-32020) or an unsupported version (-32022); 403 for a disallowed Origin; 404 for an unknown method (-32601); 413 over 256 KiB; 503 when the install has no sign-in. Read-only in AK-1; Standard edition and above.

default.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response object, or 202 with no body for a notification.
